name: Eeliya Rasta
title: Eeliya Rasta: Photography & Projects
description: Eeliya Rasta is a portrait and editorial photographer in the Netherlands, shooting on a Fujifilm X100V, who also builds websites and DIY things.

about.headline: I photograph people, the way they are when they forget the camera.
paragraphs: PLACEHOLDER BIO: I'm Eeliya, a photographer based in the Netherlands. Most of my work is portraits and editorial shoots with models, made with one small camera (a Fujifilm X100V) and whatever light the day gives me.

Photography is the hobby that took over. During the week I build things: websites, tools for developers and the occasional DIY contraption on my desk. This site is one of them, so it's equal parts portfolio and playground.
Want to shoot together, or have a project in mind? Send me a message.

photography.title: Photography
photography.intro: Two sides of the same habit: the people I photograph, and the places I keep coming back to.

people.title: People
people.intro: Models and the people I have photographed. Portraits, editorial and fashion, mostly natural light.

places.title: Places
places.intro: Buildings, streets and castles. What is left when the people walk out of frame.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Things I build when I am not behind the camera: websites, developer tools and DIY experiments.
